name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the platform in the log, and of the Doorbell accessory when it is first created.

host.title: Intercom IP address
host.description: Local IP address of the Comelit monitor or Extender, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Give it a fixed address in your router.

port.title: ViP port
port.description: TCP port of the ViP protocol. Leave at 64100.

token.title: User token
token.description: 32-character token of the Comelit user Homebridge signs in as. Find it in users.cfg inside a backup downloaded from the intercom's web page (http://<intercom-ip>:8080). See the README.

enableNotifications.title: Listen for rings
enableNotifications.description: Keep a connection open to receive rings. Without rings the lock only opens with 'Unlock allowed for' set to 0.

reconnectDelay.title: Reconnect delay (seconds)
reconnectDelay.description: Wait before reconnecting after the connection drops. If the intercom can't be reached, the wait doubles after each failed attempt.

maxReconnectDelay.title: Longest reconnect wait (seconds)
maxReconnectDelay.description: Upper limit for the doubling wait while the intercom can't be reached. The wait goes back to the reconnect delay once connected.

subaddress.title: User row number (sub-address)
subaddress.description: Row number (#) of that user on the intercom's Users page, e.g. 3. Give Homebridge its own user: a user shared with a phone gets each call on only one of them.

leaseRefreshMode.title: Registration refresh mode
leaseRefreshMode.description: The intercom stops sending rings to a registration after a few minutes, so it is refreshed regularly. Reconnect: drop and reopen the connection. In place: re-register on the open connection, with no gap.

leaseRefreshMinutes.title: Registration refresh interval (minutes)
leaseRefreshMinutes.description: How often the registration is refreshed. 2 is proven; longer intervals may miss rings.

leaseRecycleMinutes.title: Full reconnect every (minutes, in-place mode)
leaseRecycleMinutes.description: In-place mode still reconnects fully this often, as a safety net.

ringWindowSeconds.title: Unlock allowed for (seconds after a ring)
ringWindowSeconds.description: Unlock from HomeKit is refused unless a ring happened within this many seconds, or a live view without a ring is showing the entrance (or ended within this many seconds). Automations and Siri can't open a live view, so outside a ring they stay refused. 0 allows unlocking at any time.

doorbellTriggerUrl.title: Doorbell camera trigger URL
doorbellTriggerUrl.description: Called on every ring, to make a homebridge-camera-ffmpeg doorbell send the HomeKit doorbell notification. Leave empty if you don't use one, or if you use this plugin's doorbell camera.

doctorMode.title: Doctor mode: open the door on every ring
doctorMode.description: Like a doctor's office: when someone rings, the plugin answers the call and opens the first door after a short delay. Anyone who rings gets in. Always: every ring opens the door. With a HomeKit switch: adds a switch, and opens only while it's on, so you can turn it on when you expect someone, or by an automation.

condition.functionBody: return model.doctorMode === 'always' || model.doctorMode === 'switch' || model.nextVisitorSwitch === true || model.nextVisitorSwitch === 'true';

doctorModeDelaySeconds.title: Doctor mode and Next Visitor: open after (seconds)
doctorModeDelaySeconds.description: Wait this long after the ring before opening. With Record rings on, 8 or more gives a clip of who comes in (the intercom's fresh picture comes about 4-5.6 s after the ring).

doctorModeMinutes.title: Doctor mode: turn off after (minutes)
doctorModeMinutes.description: The Doctor Mode switch turns itself off after this long. 0: it stays on until you turn it off.

doctorModeSensor.title: Doctor mode: add a contact sensor
doctorModeSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor to the Doctor Mode switch: Open while doctor mode is on, Closed while off. Turn on its notifications in the Home app to be told when doctor mode turns on or off.

nextVisitorSwitch.title: Next Visitor switch
nextVisitorSwitch.description: Adds a HomeKit switch that lets the next visitor in: while it is on, the next ring opens the door, then the switch turns itself off. For an expected delivery or guest.

openRepeat.title: Buzzes per unlock
openRepeat.description: How many times each unlock sends the door release, for an entrance behind two doors: the first buzz opens the street door, the next ones the inner door. Applies to every unlock from HomeKit, and to doctor mode and Next Visitor.

openRepeatSeconds.title: Time from one buzz to the next
openRepeatSeconds.description: Seconds from the start of one buzz to the start of the next. Include how long the buzz itself lasts (about 3 s on many installations): 6 s gives a 3 s buzz and a 3 s break.

nextVisitorMinutes.title: Next Visitor: turn off after (minutes)
nextVisitorMinutes.description: If nobody rings, the switch turns itself off after this long.

nextVisitorSensor.title: Next Visitor: add a contact sensor
nextVisitorSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor to the Next Visitor switch: Open while it is on, Closed once it turns off (the visitor was let in, or its time limit passed). Turn on its notifications in the Home app.

registerPush.title: Register as a push device (original behavior)
registerPush.description: Leave off. Registering for push diverts calls away from Homebridge.

answerMode.title: Answer the ring
answerMode.description: Off: never take part in the call. Handshake only: reply to the call without answering it, so it doesn't take the call (for testing). Answer when unlocking (from Home): answer the ring, open the door inside the call, then hang up. Answer when viewing (the camera): opening the doorbell camera's live view answers the ring (needs the doorbell camera); unlocking during a ring opens inside the call, answering it first (and hanging up afterwards) if the live view isn't open.

camera.title: Doorbell camera with live video
camera.description: Adds a HomeKit doorbell camera that shows the intercom's video and audio during a ring, and rings in HomeKit itself (the camera-ffmpeg doorbell is then not needed). Video needs 'Answer when viewing the camera'. Requires ffmpeg with libfdk_aac (ffmpeg-for-homebridge).

talkBack.title: Talk back from the Home app
talkBack.description: Sends the Home app's microphone to the intercom's speaker during a live view. On by default.

videoQuality.title: Video quality
videoQuality.description: What to ask the intercom for: Standard asks for 320x240, High for up to 800x480. A 6741W sends 640x240 either way, shown as 4:3.

videoCodec.title: Video encoder
videoCodec.description: ffmpeg encoder for HomeKit, e.g. libx264 (default) or a hardware encoder your ffmpeg has. 'copy' isn't possible: the intercom's video has to be re-encoded.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Leave empty to find it automatically: ffmpeg-for-homebridge (on its own or inside homebridge-camera-ffmpeg), then /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg, then ffmpeg from the system path.

snapshotImage.title: Picture when there is no call
snapshotImage.description: A JPEG shown as the camera picture when no call is in progress. Empty, or a file that doesn't exist: the picture that comes with the plugin.

mediaStartTimeoutSeconds.title: Wait for the first video or audio (seconds)
mediaStartTimeoutSeconds.description: After answering, hang up if no video or audio arrives within this time.

mediaSilenceSeconds.title: End the call after media stops for (seconds)
mediaSilenceSeconds.description: If video and audio stop arriving for this long, the call is treated as over and hung up.

videoRefreshSeconds.title: Repeat the video request every (seconds)
videoRefreshSeconds.description: The intercom stops sending video about 35 s after a request, so it is repeated.

liveViewWaitSeconds.title: Live view: wait for the intercom's video at most (seconds)
liveViewWaitSeconds.description: When the live view opens, wait this long for the intercom's video and audio, then show the picture (the Home app gives up on slow streams).

doorVolume.title: Turn up the sound from the door by (dB)
doorVolume.description: The intercom's microphone is quiet. 12 dB is about 4 times as loud; loud sounds are limited so they don't distort. 0: as the intercom sends it.

lastVisitorMinutes.title: Show the last visitor for (minutes)
lastVisitorMinutes.description: After a call, the camera's picture, and its live view outside a call, show the last visitor this long, then the idle picture again. 0: always the idle picture.

mediaCaptureDir.title: Save each call's video and audio to (folder)
mediaCaptureDir.description: For troubleshooting only. Saves the intercom's raw video (.h264) and audio (.alaw), and your talk-back audio, for the last 10 calls, and the picture each ring's notification got (.jpg, last 10 rings). Empty: nothing is saved.

ringPreview.title: Visitor's picture in the ring notification
ringPreview.description: On a ring, gets the visitor's picture from the intercom before anyone answers, so the notification shows who is there. Doesn't answer the call. Needs the doorbell camera, and Answer the ring (or doctor mode) not off.

liveViewWithoutRing.title: Live view without a ring
liveViewWithoutRing.description: Opening the doorbell camera when nobody is ringing calls the entrance panel, as the Comelit app's camera button does, and shows its video. Closing the view hangs up. Off: outside a call the camera shows a picture. Needs the monitor in Kit mode (S3 DIP 1 ON) and the entrance panel at address 0 (on an EX-DSME, DIP 1–3 OFF). Try the Comelit app's Entrance button first: if the app can't show the entrance without a ring, this can't either.

liveViewSound.title: Sound in live view without a ring
liveViewSound.description: Off: video only. When you talk: the view starts silent; turning on the Home app's microphone calls the panel again with sound (the panel only opens the sound when a call starts), so the picture pauses for about 5 s and your first 2 s or so are lost. Always: sound from the start. With sound, the Home app hears the entrance (tap its speaker icon), the door hears you while the microphone is on (needs Talk-back), and the panel's microphone stays open until the view closes (turning the microphone off doesn't close it).

recording.title: Record rings (HomeKit Secure Video)
recording.description: Records each ring, from the intercom's first picture until it stops sending video, as a HomeKit Secure Video clip in the Home app. Needs a home hub, iCloud+, and the camera set to Stream & Allow Recording in the Home app. With Record audio on in the Home app, the clip has the door's sound during the call.

headerDisplay: Comelit ViP intercom, fully local. Give Homebridge its own Comelit user and use its token and row number (sub-address). See the [README](https://github.com/zmanuel1234/homebridge-comelit-doorbell#readme).
